title: Activities — Verified Hours, Tickets, Metro Proximity & Social Links (≤1h Central Envelope)

activities.name: Yu Garden (豫园)
activities.days: Tue–Sun (closed Mondays except national statutory holidays)
activities.exceptions: Spring Festival hours announced separately by notice. North Gate: 168 Fuyou Rd; South Gate: 279 Yuyuan Old St (individual only).
activities.metro: Metro Line 10 / Line 14 · Yuyuan Garden Station (same district as Xintiandi/Bund)

activities.name: Yu Garden Night Tour (2025 Seasonal Ref)
activities.days: Fri–Sun (closed Mon–Thu; 2025 winter schedule — 2027 schedule unconfirmed)
activities.exceptions: Feb 20, 2027 is Lantern Festival — confirm 2027 night-tour notice via official WeChat '上海豫园' or yugarden.com.cn.
activities.cost_note: 2025 ref was ¥300–436 for 2; 2027 pricing not yet published (blank/flagged).
activities.metro: Metro Line 10 / Line 14 · Yuyuan Garden Station

activities.name: Shanghai Museum East (上海博物馆东馆)
activities.days: Wed–Mon (closed Tuesdays except national statutory holidays)
activities.exceptions: Individual walk-in via B1 East Gate with original valid passport/ID; special reservation needed only for Curio-City / Digital Gallery.
activities.metro: Pudong · 1952 Century Avenue (Metro Line 2 Shanghai Science & Technology Museum)

activities.name: Shanghai Museum — People's Square
activities.days: Tue–Sun (closed Mondays except national statutory holidays)
activities.exceptions: During 'On Top of the World Tree: Ancient Civilizations of the Americas' (Jul 9, 2026 – Nov 14, 2027), no other permanent galleries are hosted here (visit East Hall for permanent displays). Book via WeChat / Trip.com.
activities.cost_note: Special exhibition requires paid ticket (exact 2027 ticket price unverified — flagged).
activities.metro: Huangpu · 201 Renmin Dadao (People's Square Metro Lines 1/2/8)

activities.name: China Art Museum (中华艺术宫)
activities.days: Tue–Sun (closed Mondays except national statutory holidays)
activities.exceptions: Special exhibitions (e.g. multimedia Qingming Shanghe Tu) may require separate reservation/ticket.
activities.metro: Pudong · 205 Shangnan Rd · Metro Line 8 China Art Museum Exit 3 / Line 7 Yaohua Rd Exit 1

activities.name: Power Station of Art (上海当代艺术博物馆)
activities.days: Tue–Sun (closed Mondays except national statutory holidays)
activities.exceptions: 678 Miaojiang Rd, Huangpu (star-rated museum per Shanghai Municipal Gov). Special exhibitions may be ticketed.
activities.cost_note: Permanent exhibitions typically free; special exhibition ticket prices unverified (blank/flagged).
activities.metro: Huangpu waterfront — same district as Bund/Xintiandi hotels

activities.name: Museum of Art Pudong (浦东美术馆)
activities.exceptions: 2777 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area (official star-rated museum list).
activities.cost_note: Ticket pricing not captured from official ticketing page (blank/flagged).

activities.name: Fosun Foundation & Rockbund Art Museum
activities.days: Fosun: Tue–Sun (closed Mon) · Rockbund: Wed–Sun (closed Mon–Tue)
activities.exceptions: Fosun Foundation: 600 East Zhongshan No. 2 Rd (BFC, beside Da Vittorio 2★); Rockbund: 20 Huqiu Rd (steps from Peninsula & 8 ½ Otto e Mezzo).
activities.cost_note: Exhibition ticket prices vary by show (blank/flagged).
activities.metro: Huangpu (The Bund) — walkable from Peninsula / EDITION / BFC

activities.name: Shanghai Tower · 118F Observatory & 52F Duoyun Bookstore
activities.exceptions: 632m tower; 118F 'Top of Shanghai' at 546m, 125–126F SKY632 Damper Performance, 52F Duoyun Bookstore (world's highest bookstore). Official site does not publish live 2027 hours/tickets statically (flagged).
activities.cost_note: Observatory ticket price unverified on official shanghaitower.com (blank/flagged).
activities.metro: Pudong · 479 Lujiazui Ring Rd / 501 Middle Yincheng Rd (Metro Lines 2/14 Lujiazui)

activities.name: Oriental Pearl Tower (东方明珠)
activities.exceptions: 468m landmark tower. Official orientalpearltower.com.cn is unreachable from sandbox; hours and ticket tiers flagged rather than guessed.
activities.cost_note: Ticket prices & hours unverified (official site unreachable from sandbox).

activities.name: Shanghai Disneyland (上海迪士尼乐园)
activities.exceptions: Sample off-peak calendar shows 08:30–21:30 (Disneytown 10:00–22:00); Feb–Mar 2027 daily hours & tiered ticket prices not yet published as of Nov 2026 (flagged). Book only via official app/website/WeChat.
activities.cost_note: Feb–Mar 2027 ticket tiers not yet published on official calendar (blank/flagged).
activities.metro: Pudong · 310 Huangzhao Rd · Metro Line 11 Disney Resort Station (longest ride on list; edge of ~1h envelope)

activities.name: The Bund Waterfront Promenade (外滩)
activities.exceptions: Free public promenade; exact official lighting shutoff schedule unverified (lighting times vary seasonally).
activities.metro: Huangpu · walkable from Peninsula / EDITION; Metro Lines 2/10 East Nanjing Rd
